notes.title: [DEV Log] Update Rumbly Progress!!
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for playing the [b]Rumbly Demo[/b]!!
We’re thrilled to see your reactions, feedback, and support.[/p][p][/p][p]Rumbly is [b]still in active development[/b] — what you're playing now is just a glimpse of what’s to come!
We're working hard to improve everything from combat mechanics to UI, character content, progression systems, and more.[/p][p]If you enjoyed the demo or want to see how the game evolves,
[b]be sure to Wishlist Rumbly[/b] and follow us to stay updated with every major step forward![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560988/401736815fec510cc9d29e8ed01be4707a31961a.png"][/img][/p][h3]Here's a sneak peek at some new enemies and bosses![/h3][p]We're cooking up brand-new challenges to test your reflexes and strategy.
Each enemy brings unique patterns, timing twists, and surprises — get ready to rethink your moves![/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates!![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560988/9d5a30d7720d6ea8c45c2b4c6c6c6a2645ea1116.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560988/127aaa17c0b11c3ffe233c0f59f5b5dc1604e4ed.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Rumbly - Update 0.1.9 is live!
notes.notes:
[p]Update 0.1.9[/p][p]We’ve made [b]major HP adjustments to many enemies[/b] across the game!
Now you can blast through battles faster and enjoy a smoother, more thrilling run.[/p][p]Try the new balance and let us know what you think!
Demo available now on Steam![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612210/Rumbly/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
